source: NIST Control Overlays for Securing AI Systems (COSAiS) concept paper

overlays.title: GenAI/LLM Assistant Overlay
overlays.description: Controls for systems using generative AI and large language models as interactive assistants, covering prompt injection, output validation, and model provenance.

overlays.title: Predictive AI Overlay
overlays.description: Controls for systems using predictive AI models for forecasting, classification, and recommendation, covering data integrity, model drift detection, and feedback loop security.

overlays.title: Single-Agent AI Overlay
overlays.description: Controls for systems with a single autonomous AI agent executing actions on behalf of a user, covering action authorization, scope limitation, and audit trail completeness.

overlays.title: Multi-Agent AI Overlay
overlays.description: Controls for systems with multiple interacting autonomous AI agents, covering inter-agent authentication, consensus verification, delegation chains, and collective action auditability.

overlays.title: AI Developer Overlay
overlays.description: Controls for systems where AI assists in software development, covering code generation validation, dependency chain security, test coverage enforcement, and deployment authorization.
